name: Question 14
problem:
A technician reviews inspection logs for defective components. The number of defects found per inspection is summarized below. If $X$ is the number of defective components found in an inspection, what is the expected value of $X?$

| Number of Inspections | $5$ | $7$ | $4$ | $3$ | $1$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Defects | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |

$\text{E}[X]=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

We're given the frequencies of the defects, so we can start by computing the corresponding probabilities. The total number of inspections is $5+7+4+3+1=20,$ so the corresponding probabilities are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=0)=f(0) & =\frac{5}{20} \\ P(X=1)=f(1) & =\frac{7}{20} \\ P(X=2)=f(2) & =\frac{4}{20} \\ P(X=3)=f(3) & =\frac{3}{20} \\ P(X=4)=f(4) & =\frac{1}{20}\end{aligned}
$$

We organize these results in the table below.

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{5}{20}$ | $\frac{7}{20}$ | $\frac{4}{20}$ | $\frac{3}{20}$ | $\frac{1}{20}$ |

Now, summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4) \\  & =0(\frac{5}{20})+1(\frac{7}{20})+2(\frac{4}{20})+3(\frac{3}{20})+4(\frac{1}{20}) \\  & =\frac{7}{20}+\frac{8}{20}+\frac{9}{20}+\frac{4}{20} \\  & =\frac{28}{20} \\  & =\frac{7}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
